windows.notes: Sharper Windows activity light with vivid colours and a tighter glow. The compact prism icon replaces the desktop edge tab; click it for rewrite controls and Settings. The bottom light appears only while refracting. No tests run for this release; Windows feedback follows installation.

mac.notes: Refract 2.0.0: new Settings and Home, badges and levels, presets and app rules, themes, insights, rewrites that do not fail, a notch handle that stays hidden until you reach for it, light strips on Windows and Linux. Full notes in docs/releases/2.0.0.md
